name: resume-tailor
title_zh: 简历改完先过AI初筛再还给你
tagline_zh: 投岗前先拿招聘方同款AI提示词自测，逐条生成面试防御话术。不堆关键词，只保真——改到能自圆其说才放行。
tagline_en: Self-test your resume against the same AI prompts recruiters use. Get per-bullet interview defenses. Authenticity.
desc_en: Tailor a resume + cover letter for a specific job from the Gauntlet pipeline, then run both through the adversarial authenticity gauntlet (the recruiter-AI screening prompts) and revise toward authenticity, not toward keyword stuffing. Also emit per-bullet interview-defense notes. Use when the user says "tailor for job <id>", "run the gauntlet", or points at a role from the morning digest.
why_zh: 它用对抗性提示词当守门员，逼你删掉经不起追问的修饰。每个bullet配防御注释，面试官深挖时你有备而来。
why_en: Adversarial self-check forces you to cut anything you can't defend. Each bullet ships with a defense note, so you walk in ready.
limit_zh: 只处理Gauntlet管道里带岗位ID的简历；不解析PDF，需Markdown源文件。产出到防御注释为止。
limit_en: Only works with Gauntlet pipeline job IDs. Needs Markdown source, not PDF. Stops at defense notes—no full cover letter generation.
title_en: Resume that survives recruiter-AI screening before you.
